S Key modifications (changes were made):
- Only words of 2-4 Han characters are kept (the keyboard never looks up other lengths).
- Prefer a concise, complete common sense; retain full source definitions when no safe short
  sense is available. Do not cut clauses at prepositions or delete words solely for length.
  Remove display annotations, expand sb/sth to someone/something, and keep proper-name spelling.
- third_party/space_glossary/overrides.tsv provides curated corrections and common missing words,
  including fixes for incomplete definitions. Overrides follow CC-CEDICT traditional forms.
  The overrides are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 as part of this derived glossary.
- English word frequencies from third_party/open_dictionaries/skey_english.tsv
  (CC BY-SA 4.0 / SCOWL) are used only to rank candidate senses; no text from that list is
  copied into the glossary.
No contextual disambiguation is performed. The derived glossary data is distributed under
CC BY-SA 4.0.
Rebuild: python3 scripts/build_space_glossary.py
